q: What does a lender ask for a solar water heating loan in a factory?
title: Solar thermal loan: what lenders ask
short: Show how much fuel or electricity now heats water or process fluid, the supplier design with expected yield, and where the collectors go. After commissioning, show the fall in fuel or power bills. The avoided fuel times its emission factor is the carbon benefit.
audience: Dairies, textile units, hotels and food processors preheating water

ul: Fuel invoices or electricity used for heating.
Hot water volume and temperature, if measured.
Fuel or power bills for the same season.
Flow and temperature log from the solar loop, if fitted.

p: A design yield from the supplier, checked later against your own bills.

example.title: Worked example
lines: LPG for water heating: 900 kg a month
Solar preheat cuts this by 40%: 360 kg a month
Saving: 360 kg x 2.98 kg = 1.07 t CO2 a month

senseible: Senseible measures your baseline from your own bills before the project and keeps measuring after it, so the saving you show a lender comes from documents, not a brochure. Lenders decide on the loan.
